display_name: MiniMax H3 Text to Video + Audio (8-step turbo)
description: Text-to-video with native stereo audio (dialogue, SFX, music generated together) using MiniMax H3 FL2VA pruned int8 + 8-step turbo LoRA. 24fps. Frame counts snap up to 5+17n (124 = ~5s, 362 = 15s max). ~3-5 min per 5s clip on the 5090 Prompt tips: describe SHOTs in order, end with an 'Audio:' line; dialogue as (S1): <d>[English] words</d>. Needs at least 18 GB of swap active (~44GB RAM peak) and nothing else on the GPU. Long jobs return status 'running': poll get_job_result with wait_seconds.

prompt.description: Shot-by-shot scene description plus an 'Audio:' line describing sound/music/dialogue

frames.description: Frame count at 24fps, snapped up to 5+17n (124=~5s, 243=~10s, 362=15s)

steps.description: Sampling steps (8 matches the turbo LoRA)
